description: Migrate a v1 config to a v2 schema with an explicit mapping, and list what was dropped or defaulted — Applies a declared mapping (from pointer, to pointer, optional transform such as string-to-number or a value map) to a v1 JSON config, carries over unmapped keys the v2 schema declares, fills schema defaults, validates the result against the v2 JSON Schema 2020-12 and returns the migrated config plus three exact lists: dropped (v1 values that landed nowhere, with their JSON pointers), defaulted (v

applyDefaults.description: Fill missing v2 properties from schema defaults (default true).

carryDeclared.description: Copy unmapped v1 values to the same pointer when v2 declares that property (default true).

drop.description: Acknowledge that this v1 value is intentionally discarded.

to.description: JSON pointer in v2; omit with drop true.

valueMap.description: Object of {stringified old value: new value} for transform value-map.

v2Schema.description: The new config's schema. Full JSON Schema 2020-12 (local $ref only).

name: config-migration
